name: agentic-cms
description: Plugins of agentic-cms: a site whose content is files, validated at build time, with an AI agent as its editor

plugins.name: editorial
plugins.description: The agent's side of a CMS whose content is files: skills that add, write, translate, review, retire and report on the content of a site built from files, with the site's own voice rules read from the repo, never from the plugin

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: The design skills of agentic-cms: design a site on the kit from the wireframe to a look of its own, one element at a time through candidates the owner picks from, measured, with icons and graphics of its own, and proven on its pixels before anything merges; and the setup of a clone
